name: Out of Stock Display Manager for WooCommerce
author: Charlie

sections.description:
A focused tool for managing per-product exceptions for out-of-stock items. Keep WooCommerce’s global “hide out of stock” setting as-is while choosing which sold-out products stay visible (shop + search, shop only, search only) or become hidden.

  • Bulk update out-of-stock products (20 per page) with search + pagination.
  • Visibility modes: Shop + Search, Shop only, Search only, Hidden.
  • Uses WooCommerce’s product_visibility terms (exclude-from-catalog, exclude-from-search, outofstock).
  • Complements the global WooCommerce out-of-stock visibility setting—does not replace it.
sections.installation:
From your WordPress dashboard
1. Visit Plugins > Add New
2. Search for “Out of Stock Display Manager”
3. Install the plugin
4. Activate the plugin
5. Go to Products -> Out of Stock Visibility to manage exceptions.
